name: Teo Marchetti
title: Captain
role: Captain of the Meridian, when the player isn't
note: Captain of the Meridian. A gunnery officer who stands and fights, and whose gun crews would follow him anywhere. The transports aren't so sure.
appearance: Big, loud and always a little sooty, with burn scars on both forearms and his sleeves rolled up over them. He laughs more than anyone else in the fleet, and nobody's sure why.
personality: Warm, quick and impatient. He remembers everyone's name and hates meetings. He'd rather be shot at than sit through a council vote, and he's said so to the council.
voice: Loud and friendly, with a lot of first names. "Come on, then. What's the worst that can happen? No, don't answer that, Marrow."
goals: Hurt the Choir, keep the fleet's spirits up, and never again be the one who didn't fire.
secrets: He froze for nine seconds in the last battle at the Graveyard, and a ship he could have covered died in those nine seconds, with everyone aboard. Nobody knows. It's why he never runs now, whether or not he should.
